detail.longDescription: Zapier today announced that its connector is now available in Meta's Muse agent. Once authorized, users can connect Muse to more than 9,000 apps and 40,000 actions through Zapier MCP. With Zapier MCP, Muse can take action across the tools your team already uses, but only the specific apps and actions you approve. That gives everyone from individuals to enterprises a secure way to run Muse as an always-on agent. For example, give Muse read-only access to your CRM and permission to post in Slack,
